[spoiler=[b]Starbound RP: Whitney Investigation[/b]]

[b]16th January 2167 - Aktus Sphere - 8th Fleet - KN Forward to Victory[/b]

The 8th Fleet was dispatched on the 11th of January to secure the sector between Aceldix and Korrin for any potential Federation attacks and ordered to maintain combat readiness for mobilisation from Palleon or Aceldama. The fleet had detected a Federation vessel operating in the Aktus sphere during their deployment in deep space, however could not reach the vessel in time and identified it as a simple trade ship. Then, on the 15th of January, the fleet detected strange activity and a concentration of troops on the moon, and afterwards the fleet moved in to investigate...

Officers inside the command room of the[i] KN Forward to Victory[/i] were attempting to calibrate the electronics in the ship, fine-tuning the dials of their reconnaissance systems and forward observers to get a clear view of the moon; however, Kartovsky disruptions were causing all electronics in the fleet to continuously fail, and even the closest Comet-class failed to get any readings following the upsurge on the 15th. Chief Petty Officers vigorously worked on their computers to reach for any signal or unusual aspect on the moon; however, long-range visual cameras were useless, as the moon was hidden underneath a heavy atmosphere of gases and smog.

Captain Decimus Arcadum, commanding officer of the destroyer, stood impatiently in the middle of the room, pacing it back and forth for any new developments, his eyes peeking over the shoulders of his subordinates to look at their screens. [i]"At the current speed and course, we shall begin decelerating in a few hours."[/i] One of the navigators exclaimed, only being met with a cold nod of acknowledgement from the captain, turning his head to gaze at the distant moon of Aceldama. Its rocky, gloomy surface hidden beneath a dark veil of gases.

The doors to the command room opened suddenly, and the commander, the second-highest-ranking officer in the ship, marched inside and urgently approached the captain. Once he walked to the captain, he clicked his heels together and, in the same motion, swung his right hand into a salute.

[i]"Urgent news from communications, sir!"[/i] The commander shouted loudly and only lowered his hand once Arcadum motioned him to. [i]"Systems have been rebooted as per your request due to the Kartovsky particles, however our comms team managed to pick up on news from Aceldama while investigating the anomaly. It wasn't hard to find out, but the Kartovsky particles did make it more challenging."[/i]

[i]"Well then, get on with it, what's the news?"[/i] Arcadum asked impatiently, his eyes furrowing.

[i]"Captain. The local news reported an attack. A mobile suit engaged with Aceldix forces at the same time we picked up the signals. From what comms could gather, it went on and massacred a bunch of civies." [/i]The commander replied calmly and slowly, letting out each word with a heavy weight.

[i]"An attack?"[/i] Arcadum replied loudly. [i]"So then that's what we picked up, whatever the hell they were fighting. Was the mobile suit ours?"
[/i]
[i]"No sir, too primitive to be our mobile suits. Reports say it was taken down by a single shot from a tank; we heard it was completely destroyed in an explosion, pilot and all."[/i] The commander replied.

[i]"Hmm, then definitely not ours. Any idea whose mobile suit it was?"[/i] Arcadum asked.

[i]"No, sir. Some say it was Palleon, others claim it's the Federation. If I were to guess, it's the latter."[/i]

[i]"This does seem like Federation work, butchering civies in rebellious colonies. Anything else we can gather?"[/i] Arcadum replied, his eyes widened at such a turn of events.

[i]"No, sir."[/i]

[i]"F**k, report this all back to Korrin before we reach Kartovsky Range. As for us, we'll change our course and head straight for Aceldama; we're going to investigate this thoroughly."[/i]

[i]"Shouldn't we first reach out to command? Initiating an investigation will mean we are unable to guard our assigned sector."[/i] The commander questioned, his eyes squinting at Arcadum.

[i]"We have a perfect opportunity lying destroyed on the surface of that moon. If it is a Fed mobile suit, then we should gather as much information as possible before our invasion. If command gets angry at my decision, I can take their grilling, I've been grilled before."[/i] Arcadum chuckled and shook his head, turning away from the commander and facing back to the front of the room. [i]"Send the Aceldix a message using standard signals; inform them we are willing to help investigate and clear things up."[/i]

The commander paused for a moment and nodded, taking a step back towards the navigators and ordering them to land in Aceldama. Then the commander wrote out a message which was transmitted to the Aceldix government:

[i]"Aceldama, Aceldama, Aceldama. This is a Korrin Navy Fleet, reporting from the destroyer KN Forward to Victory, do you copy? We come with friendly intentions, do you copy? We heard about the massacre on your moon; our deepest condolences. We wish to cooperate, we wish to help investigate the mobile suit you destroyed. Our assistance will help find the culprit. Do you copy? We are a fleet of two destroyers, two frigates, and a corvette. Please respond, we are approaching your moon."[/i][/spoiler]

To the most esteemed leader of the Interstellar Shamatist Corporate Order State, and their honorable cabinet, 

After a swift and deliberate review of our current position in the Six Republics, and with approval from the transitional Provisional Congress, the Ministry of Interplanetary Affairs would love to return the hand of cooperation and good business with the ISCOS, particularly given the vital position in which the ISCOS occupies as an independent party in the Ardagan system. This transmission contains a bilateral accord, or as we would refer to it, a Treaty of Friendship, by which we put our hopes towards the proliferation of goodwill between our nations. The signing of this treaty will enact the following terms into effective order: 

[b]- The Parties confirm that, following constructive and substantive consultations, they have agreed to the formal establishment and progressive development of relations between the Combine of Eirian and the Interstellar Shamatist Corporate Order State.
- The Parties henceforth reaffirm their mutual recognition of each other as legitimate governing authorities and their commitment to relations which are wholly founded on equality, reciprocity, mutual respect, and principles of peaceful coexistence and shared prosperity; therefore, both Parties shall emphasize their shared intention to conduct relations in good faitha nd full respect of each other's political independence, legal order, and internal proccesses.

- In the interest of maintaining peace and stability through Ardagan, the Parties reiterate their commitment to non-aggression and building of confidence. The signing of this Treaty will therefore enact a non-aggression pact between the Parties, which is only nullified upon the occurrence of open hostilities or other stated reasons between the Parties.
- The Parties will henceforth agree that this Treaty of Friendship shall constitute a foundational framework for continued relations between the Parties. They express a shared intent to deepen and broaden cooperation over time through understanding, protocol, or agreements, as mutually agreed  
- Any differences arising in the course of the implementation of this Treaty of Friendship shall be addressed through dialogue and consultation in a constructive and cooperative spirit.[/b]

To address the previous offer of an open trade, with a specific highlight to the trade of produce and other items, the Combine is highly interested, given the current situation of the Federation's ban on food resources beyond the Belt of Tears. The Combine of Eirian, therefore, offers its riches of rare-earth metals from Hyperborea's underseas as well as the might of its industries, by which Eirian would be able to [b]trade shipments of advanced materials, manufactured goods, medicines, and machine parts vital.[/b]Furthermore, we promise a transition, over six months upon trade beginning, from the standard tariff of [b]10% to 5%, as well as the protection of ISCOS trade ships by the Eirian Settlement Defense Fleet.[/b]     

We await your response, and hopefully your signature.

Long Live the Combine, Long Live the Six Republics, Long Live Eirian

Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60940754][b]Ad Korrin[/b]

The Marquesse Chambourd sped along the empty space of the Ardagan system, onboard, Joseph Consantinus sat comfortably in the flight lounge, observing the stars as they whizzed by. The Marquesse had been dispatched almost immediately following the announcement of the Dictat of Consantinus. Indeed, Joseph had little time to prepare for the trip, being informed an hour before getting herded onboard the cruiser by the SCSID that he had been selected for a special diplomatic mission to the colony of Korrin to secure a deal under the Dictat. 

Of course, the mission was a cover up by the SCSID which had determined Joseph to be an improper royal candidate, preferring the son of Alexander IV, Kyrios Consantinus to be an heir to the Vespurian crown. However, the SCSID knew that they had to move carefully, thus with the careful assent of the Chief Consul they had resolved a plot to remove Joseph tragically from the lineup. 

The plan was simple, secure the terms of the deal with Korrin and then tragically have the Marquesse blow up en-route to Erene, while Joseph would be quietly transferred prior to the explosion to an alternate cruiser which would take him to a special safe-house in Rosenmarkke where hed sign a document prepared to look as if it had been signed prior to his trip to Korrin, where he foreswore any claim to the Vespurian throne. Hed then be declared legally dead and walked quietly off the public scene.

It was a brilliant plan, and one which Joseph had not been briefed upon, thus, as he sat staring out the window of the Marquesse, he was not alarmed to see three SCSID officers enter the room, nor was he alarmed when they quietly informed him that he was a traitor of Rosenmarkke, and commanded to finish the deal with Korrin before having his sentence executed upon him.

Thus the Marquesse came near to Korrins skies, sending the calming message [i] We are here, Nostre Amie revolucionate[/i] (We are here, your friends, revolutionaries).
----------------------------
[nation]Greater Rostoria[/nation][/quote]

Korrin was a rather advanced colony. Large amounts of Federation funds were spent into the space infrastructure of the colony as it was the focal point in Aktus sphere colonisation, and thus Korrin had the capacity for both large trade and military fleets. Korrin had dozens of space stations positioned outside the moon's Kartovsky Range, some of its dockyards and trade posts were built in deep space but importantly all of its space communications stations were built far away to prevent disruptions. This made Korrin an efficient colony, one which was able to respond quickly to any incoming vessels.

The Marquesse was first detected by a Comet-class corvette, which tracked and observed the ship during its voyage in deep space. As the ship approached Korrin's Kartovsky Range it was intercepted by two mobile suits, their engines managing to close the distance in little time, then the two proceeded to circle around the vessel inspecting it for any weapons or markings. Soon after, a Korrin destroyer approached the Marquesse, though its weapons were not targeting the ship and instead it seemed to escort the the Marquesse towards Korrin's surface.

As the ship began to decelerate, the mobile suits returned back to the destroyer, and smaller docking craft with bright lights appeared to help the Marquesse in its descent down to a dock. Soon after the calming message was received, a reply was sent back from one of the communications station.

[i]"We received your message. We understand, and welcome you. You have permission to dock at Hangar 43, in Sector 7, coordinates have been provided. You will be escorted and guided."[/i]

The Rosenmarkke ship was led towards a small city, towering skyscrapers rising over the barren world while large refineries spewed smog into space. A large visible rail network could be seen by Joseph, taking ores from the mines of the moon towards the large automated factories, while countless merchant ships made trips to and from the cargo yards. The docking craft guided the Marquesse towards a underground circular dock, which opened up and allowed the ship to land. Large grappling hooks locked onto the Marquesse and held it in place as a bridge was positioned outside the doors of the ship.
